title: SynthrAI after the rebuild: launch how, for how many?
decision: How to launch SynthrAI with the decision report, councils and council session, and how many users and payers in 12 months.

options.label: Focused launch around the decision report

graham.reason: Real demand: does the report make people want it

hormozi.reason: Is a tested decision worth paying for

garyvee.reason: Video and shared reports as distribution

bezos.reason: Strategy and reversibility of a broad launch

naval.reason: Shared reports and content as owned assets

musk.reason: What is missing before anything works

brief: The founder rebuilt SynthrAI around the last council's advice: a scored, shareable decision report, an automatic three-round council session, 13 ready-made councils, cost caps and a promo video. Production secrets and the English interface are not done; no users yet.
assumptions: Market sizes are the seats' own estimates
